title: Surf Air Mobility Inc. 8-K — Registered Direct Offering
summary: Surf Air Mobility Inc. conducted a registered direct offering of 13,318,181 common shares at $1.10 per share to LamVen LLC and another institutional investor, with gross proceeds of approximately $15 million. Directors and officers participated separately at $1.36 per share (the April 17 closing price). The offering closed on April 21, 2026, and includes a 30-day restricted period on additional share issuances.
key_points: Offering consisted of 13,318,181 shares at $1.10/share to LamVen LLC and one institutional investor
Directors and officers purchased 257,353 shares at $1.36/share (April 17 NYSE closing price)
Gross proceeds of approximately $15 million before fees and expenses
Company had 84,315,976 shares outstanding as of April 17, 2026
30-day restricted period prevents additional common stock or equivalents issuance
Filing includes opinion from Cleary Gottlieb Steen & Hamilton LLP
